Panduan Ziarah Kubur

1. Salam Masuk Area Pemakaman

AssalaaMu 'Alaikum Daara Qoumin Mu'Miniin. Wa inNaa in SYaa-AllooHu BiKum LaaHiQuun. As-AlullooHa LaNaa Wa LaKumul 'AaFiYah.

Semoga keselamatan tercurah kepada kalian, wahai penghuni negeri kaum beriman. Insyaallah kami akan menyusul kalian. Kami memohon keselamatan kepada Allah untuk kami dan kalian.

2. Doa Menyiram Air

AllooHumMaj'al HaaDzal Maa-a Sababan Lir RohMati Wal MaghFiRoti Wa TakhFiiFil 'AdZaab.

Ya Allah, jadikanlah air ini sebagai sebab turunnya rahmat, ampunan, dan keringanan azab.

3. Doa Menabur Bunga

AllooHumMaj'al HaaDziHil AzHaaRo RohMatan Wa NuuRon Wa Salaaman 'Alaa Ahli HaaDzal Qobri.

Ya Allah, jadikanlah bunga-bunga ini sebagai rahmat, cahaya, dan kedamaian bagi penghuni makam ini.

DOA TAHLIL

A'uudZubillaaHi Minasy SyaiThoonir RoJiim, BismillaaHir Rohmanir Rohiim,

Al hamdu lillaaHil LadZi lam YatTaKhiu WaLadau Wa lam Yakul LaHuu SyaRiiku Fil Mulk, Wa lam Yakul Lahuu WaLii Yum MinadZ dZulli WakabBirhu Takbiro

AlloohumMa anta robBUNAA Laa illaaHa illaa Anta. KhoLaqtaNaa Wa Nahnu 'ibaaduka, Wa Nahnu 'Alaa Ahdika, Wa Wa'dika MastaThoq'NAA, Na'uudZubika min SyarRi Maa Shonaq'naa, naBuu'u laka Bini'matika 'AlaiNaa, Wa nABuu'u BidZuNuubiNaa, Fagh-FirLaNaa Fa inNaHuu Laa YaGhfirudZ dZuNuuba illaa Anta.

AlloohumMa Yaa Alloohu Yaa ‘ALiiyu Yaa ‘AZhiimu Yaa haLiimu Yaa ‘ALiim. Anta RobBii, Wa ’ilmuka hasBii, Faniq’mar RobBu-RobBii, Waniq’mal hasBu-hasBii, TanShuru Man-TaSya'u, Wa Antal ‘aZiizur Rohiim.

Wa illaa hukum illaaHu Waahidul Laa illaaHa illaa Huwar RohMaanur Rohiim. Alloohu Laa illaaHa illaa Huwal haiyul QoiYuum,

AlloohumMa inNi As 'Aluka Bi AnNi ASyhadu AnNaka Antalloohu, Laa illaaHa illaa Anta, antal AhaduSh Shomad, AlladZi lam Yalid Wa lam YuLad, Wa lam Yakul Lahu Kufuwan Ahad.

AlloohumMa TaqobBal Wa AuShil tSaWaaba maa Qoro’Naahu Minal Qur'aanil 'AZhiim. Wa Maa HallalNaa, Wa Maa SabBahNaa, Wa MastaGhFarNaa, Wa Maa TaShoddaqoNaa, Wa Maa ShollaiNaa, 'Alaa SaiyidiNaa MuhamMadin Shollallohu 'Alaihi Wasallam. Hadiiyatam Minna, Wa Shilatan, Wa Rohmatan, Naazilatan, Wa barokatan Syaa-Milah

iLaa ArWaahi JaMii'il Ahlil QuBuuri, Minal MusliMiina Wal MusliMaat, Wal MukmiNiina Wal MukmiNaat, min MaSyaariqil ArDhi, Wa MaGhoori-Bihaa, BarRihaa Wa Bahrihaa, KhuShuuShon iLaa ABaa’iNaa, Wa UmMaHaatiNaa, Wa Aj-Daa-DiNaa, Wa Jad-Daatina

Wa Khush-Shol KhuShuuShon iLaa haDhroti Bapak Soemadji bin Kardi Adisukarto, Bapak Sido Utomo bin Karto Sidi, ibu Sukilah binti Martam Wongso Prawiro, Bapak Moedjono bin Mbah KabuL Karnadi

iLaa Manij-Tamaq'Naa haaHuNaa BisaBaa-bihii Wa Liajlih.

AlloohumMaGhFir Lahu, WarhamHu, Wa 'Aafihi Wafu'AnHu. Wa Akrim NuzuLaHu, Wagh-SilHu Bil Maa'i, WatS-tSalji, Wal Barod.

AlloohumMa NawWir Qobrohu, Wa WasSi' Mud-KhoLaHu.

AlloohumMaj'al Qobrihi RouDhotam min RiYaaDhil JanNah. Wa Laa Taj'al Qobrihi hufrotam Min hufarin-Naar. Waftah Lahu Fii Qobrihi Baaban ilal Jannah. AlloohumMa tSabBit-Hu 'indas Su-Aal.

Alloohumma 'idz-Hu Min 'adZaabil Qobri. Wa Min Fitnatil Qobri. Wa Min 'adZaabin Naar.

AlloohumMarfa' DaroJaataHu Fil MahDiiYiin.

WakhLuf-Hu Fii 'aqibiHim, Fil GhoobiRiin.

Waghfir LaNaa Wa Lahu. Yaa Robbal 'Aalamiin.

AlloohumMaj'alHu Ma'an NabiiYiina, Wash Shid-DiiQiina, Wasy SyuHaDaa'i, Wash Shoolihiin.

AlloohumMa Yaa Ahad Sholli 'Alaa Ahmad. AlloohumMa Yaa Ahad Sholli 'Alaa MuhamMad. AlloohumMa Yaa Ahad Sholli 'alal MahDii. KhoLiiFatika Yaa Allooh Yaa Ahad

AlloohumMa Anzilir Rohmatan, Wal MaGhfirotan, 'Alaa Ahlil QuBuuri Min Ahli, Laa illaaHa illallooHu MuhamMadur RoSuulullooh.

Yaa Muhaiminu Yaa SaLaam, SallimNaa Wal MusliMiin, Fid-DunYaa Wal AaKhiroh, Birohmatika Yaa Arhamar RoohiMiin.

AlloohumMa inNaa Nas’aluka RiDhooka Wal JanNah, Wa Na'uudZu Bika min SaKhoThika WanNaar.

AlloohumMar-hamHu Bil Qur'Aanil 'AZhiimir Rohmatan, Waasi'atan, WaGhfir LaHu MaGhfirotan, Jaami'atan, Yaa Maalikad DunYaa Wal AaKhiroti, Yaa RobBal 'AalaMiin.

AlloohumMaj'al Lil Qur'Aanil 'AZhiim, Fii Qobrihii Muq'nisan, Wa Fiil QiYaamati Syaafi'an, Wa Fiil HaSyri DhiYaa'an, Wa Zhillan, Wa DaLiilan, Wafi MiiZaani Roojihan, Wa 'Alaa ShiRooThi Nuuron, Wa Qooidan, Wa 'Anin-Naari Sitron, Wa hiJaaban, Wa Fiil JanNati RoFiiqon

AlloohumMa Anzil Fii Qobrihii Rohmatan, WaDh-DhiYaa'A, Wan-Nuuro, Wal Bahjata, War-Rouha, War-Roihaana, Was-SuRuuro, Min YaumiNaa HadZaa, iLaa Yaumil Baq'tSi, WanuSyuuri inNaka Malikun RobBun GhoFuur.

RobBaNaa Atmim LaNaa Nuur-RoNaa WaGhfir LaNaa inNaka 'Alaa Kulli Syai’ing qoDiir

Alloohumma innii As’aluka Bihaqqi Suurati al-WAAQI‘ah Wa AsRooriHaa, Wa AnWaariHaa, An TarzuqoNii Rizqon Waasi‘an halaalan Thoyyiban, Min Ghoiri Kaddin, Wa laa Nashabin, Wa laa Man-nin, Wa laa Ta‘abin, Wa Tuyas-Siro Lii Umuurii KullaHaa, Wa Taqdhiya hawaa’ijii, innaka ‘Alaa Kulli Syai’iin Qodiir.

Doa Setelah Al-Waqi'ah

AllooHumMa inNi As 'Aluka Bi AnNi Asyhadu AnNaka Antalloohu, Laa illaaHa illaa Anta; antal AhaduSh Shomad AlladZi Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yulad Wa Lam Yakul Lahu Kufuwan Ahad.

AllooHumMa Sholli 'Alaa Sayyidina MuhamMadin Sholatan Tuwassi'u BiHaa 'Alainal Arzaaqo, Watuhas Sinu BiHaa Lanal Akhlaaqo Wa 'Alaa 'AaliHi WaShohbi Wasallim

Alloohumma innii As’aluka Rizqon Thoyyiban, Wa ‘ilman NAAFI‘an, Wa ‘Amalan Mutaqob-balan, Wa Qolban Khooshi‘an, Wa Lisaanan dZaakiron, Wa Badanan ‘Alal-Balaa’i Shoobiron.

Alloohumma in Kaana Rizqunaa Fii As-Samaa’i Fa Anzilhu,

Wa in Kaana Fil-ardhi Fa Akhrij-HU,

Wa in Kaana Ba‘iidan FAqorribu,

Wa in Kanna qoliilan faka-tsirhu,

Wa in Kaana KatSiiron Fa Baarik Lanaa Fiih, Birohmatika Yaa Arhamar-Roohimīn.

AlloohumMa In Kaana Maa Ad‘Uu Bihi MusTahiilan Fa Anta al Qoodiru SuBhaanaka, Laa Yuq‘Jizuka Syai'un Fil Ardhi, wa Laa Fis SaMaa-i.

AllooHumMa in Kaana SyarRon, Faj‘alhu Khoiron, WarzuqNii Bihi Yaa Alloohu, Yaa Mudab-Biral layli Wan-NaHaar.

Alloohumma Yassir Lanaa Kulla Shoq‘Bin, Wahlul kulla ‘Uqdatin, Wa Naj-jinaa Min Kulli ham-min, Wa Ghommin, Wa Karbin.

Alloohumma laa sahla illaa maa Ja‘Altahuu sahla, wa anta Taj ‘Alul hazna idza Syiq’ta sahla

Alloohumma iqdhi, wa naffis Kuroobanaa, Wakfinaa Maa Aham-Manaa Wa Maa Aghom-Manaa

AllooHumMa Sahil Lii Mathlabi, Wa Yassir Lii MaqShiDii, WarzuqNii Bitaskhiirin Minka, Waj ‘Al Khuthuwaatii MuBaarokah, Waftah Lii Abwaaba Fadhlik, Wa Baarik Lii Fii RizQii Wa‘umRii, Waj‘Alnii Mina asSaa‘i-Diina Al Muflihiin.

Baddil Dhiqii farojan, Wa ‘Ajzii QuWWatan, Wa Ahlaamii WAAQI‘an. Wa AkhrijNii Min hawlii iLaa hawLik, Wa Min DHOQ'Fii iLaa QuuWatika.

Wa Kulla Maa Ataman-Naahu Min AmRii AiyaKuuna, Fa inNaHu Laa Faa‘ila LiMaa TuRiiduHu siWaak. Wa Laa Yuq‘jizuka Syai'un, Wa Laa YaSh‘Ubu ‘alaik.

AllooHumMa al Khofiiyyi Anaa Muhtaajun Dzaliilun, Wa Anta Al-Qowiyyul Ghoniyy

AlloohumMa Yaa Sarii‘al-hiSaab, Yaa Syadiidal ‘iQoob, Yaa GhoFuur, Yaa Rohiim. Wa Yaa Khooliqo Kulli Syai’, Yaa Faathiros Samaawaati Wal-ardh,

Yaa Faaliqol Wan-Nawaa, Yaa Faaliqol ishBaah.

Yaa Waliyyal hasaNaat, Yaa Daafi‘as Sayi’aat,

Yaa Ghoofirol KhoThii’aat, Yaa Saatirol-awroot,

Yaa Maani‘AL Baliyyaah. Yaa Muqiilal ‘AtSaRoot,

Yaa Muhyiyal AmWaat, Yaa Munawwiral Ardhi Was-SaMaaWaati. iqdhii haajaTii Fii Haadzihis-Saa‘Aat.

Yaa ilaaHal AwwaLiina Wal-AakhiRiin,

Yaa Badi‘As-SaMaaWaati Wal Ardh,

Yaa dZal-Jalaali wal-ihRoom. Wa Shollalloohu ‘alaa SaiyidiNaa MuhamMadin Wa ‘Alaa Aalihi Wa Shohbihi Ajma’iin. Walhamdu Lillaahi Robbil ‘Aalamiin.

AllooHumMa Tajallaa Lii Bi-iroodaTika Yaa AllooH, Wa Qudrotika, Wa haulika, Wa Quwwatika, Wa QohHarika, Wa JabBaarika, inNama AmruHu idZa aRooda Syaian Aiyaquula Lahu Kun Fayakun

Wa Tajallaa ‘Alaiya Bi Anwaari rohmatika, Wa Asroori qudrotika, Waftah Lii Abwaaba Fadhlika, Wa Ahyi Qolbii Binuuri ma‘rifatika, Waj‘alnii Minal Mukhlishiina Fii Mahab-Batika, WarzuqNii Bi_Qodhoika, Birohmatika Yaa Arhamar Roohimiin.

AllooHumMa RobBaNaa Anzil 'Alaina Maa' idatam Minas Samaa'i Takuunu LaNaa 'iidal Lil-AwaliNaa Wal AakhiriNaa Wa ayatam minka warzuqNaa Wa 'anta Khoirur Rooziqin 3X

Surat Al-Mulk

30 AYAT • MODE HAFALAN AKTIF

24Qul Huwal-LaDzii Dzaro-Akum Fil arDhi Wa ilaiHi tuhSyaRuun

25WayaQuu Luuna maTaa HaaDzaL waq’du in Kuntum ShoodiQiin

26Qul inNamal ‘ilmu ‘indallooHi wa inNaMaa aNaa naDziirum MuBiin

28Qul aro’aitum in ahlaka niyallooHu wamam-Ma’iya AuRohimaNaa, famai yuJiirul KaafiRiina min ‘aDzaabin aLiim

29Qul Huwar RohMaanu AamanNaa biHi wa ‘alaiHi tawak- KalNaa; Fasataq’ laMuuna man Huwa fii DhoLaalim muBiin

30Qul aro’aitum in 'aSh-baha Maa ’ukum Ghouron famai yaq’Tiikum biMaa’im Ma’iin

Doa Setelah Al-Mulk

Allahumma Aj’alna Mim-Man Yatlu Suratul Al Mulk,

Wa Yantafi’u Biha, Wa Yuq’minu Bi Ayatiha, Wa Yaq’malu Bimuh kamiha, Wa Yatajan-nabu Mutasya bihiha, Waj’alna Nuron Lana Fi Quburina, Wa Muq’nisatan Lana Fi Wahdatina, Wa Syafi’atan Lana Yaumal Qiyamah.

Allahumma Naj-jina Min ‘Azabil Qobri, Wa Min ‘Azabil Jahan-Nam, Wa Min Fitnatil Mahya Wal Mamat, Wa Min Fitnatil Masihid Dajjal, Wa adkhilnal Jan-nata Ma’al Abroor, Ya ‘Azizu Ya Ghoffar, Ya RobBal ‘Alamin.

DOA SETELAH SHOLAT

A’uudZu BillaaHi MinaSy SyaiThoonir Rojiim, BismillaaHir Rohmanir Rohiim, Al hamdu LillaHil LadZi Lam YatTakHiu Waladau Wa Lam Yakul LaHuu SyaRiiku Fil Mulk, Wa Lam Yakul Lahuu WaLii Yum MinadZ dZulli WakabBirhu Takbiro.

AllooHumMa anta robbi Laa ilaaHa illaa Anta. KholaqtaNii Wa ANaa 'Abduka, Wa ANaa 'ALaa Ahdika Wawa'dika MastaTho'tu, A'uudzubika Min SyarRi Maa Shona'tu, Abuu'u Laka Bini'matika 'Alaiya, Wa Abuu'u Bidzam Bii FaGhfir Lii, Fa innaHuu Laa YaGhfirudz DzuNuuba illaa Anta

AllooHumMa Yaa AllooHu Yaa ‘ALiiyu Yaa ‘AZhiimu, Yaa haLiimu Yaa ‘ALiim. Anta RobBii, Wa ’ilmuka hasBii, Faniq’mar RobBu-RobBii, Waniq’mal hasBu-hasBii, TanShuru Man-TaSya'u, Wa Antal ‘aZiizur Rohiim.

Wa illaa hukum illaaHu Waahidul Laa ilaaHa illaa Huwar RohMaanur Rohiim. AllooHu Laa ilaaHa illaa Huwal haiyul Qoiyuum.

AllooHumMa inNi As 'Aluka Bi Anni ASyhadu Annaka AntallooHu, Laa illaaHa illaa Anta, antal AhaduSh Shomad. AlladZi Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yulad, Wa Lam Yakul Lahu Kufuwan Ahad.

AllooHumMa Sholli Wasallim ‘ALaa SaiyidiNaa MuhamMad Wa ‘ALaa Aalihi SaiyidiNaa MuhamMadin ShoLaatan TunjiiNaa BiHaa Min JaMiiq’il AhWaali Wal Aafaat.

Wa TaqDhii LaNaa BiHaa JaMiiq’al HaaJaat. Wa TuTho hiruNaa BiHaa Min JaMiiq’is Saiyiq’Aat. Wa Tar Faq’uNaa BiHaa ‘iindaka ‘AqLaad-DaroJaat.

Wa TuballiGhuNaa BiHaa AqShol GhooYaati Min JaMiiq’il hoiRootifil haYaati Wa Baq’dal MaMaat. inNaHu SaMiiq’un QoRiibu MuJiibud-Daq’aWaat, Wa Yaa QooDhiyal HaaJaat.

Wa ‘ALaa AaliHi WaShobiHi Wabarik Wasalim Tasliman KaThiro, Birohmatika Yaa Arhamar RohiiMiin.

AllooHumMaGh-Fir LaNaa dZuNuu BaNaa Wali WaalidiNaa, Warham-Hum KaMaa RobBaGhNaa ShiGhooro. Wali MaSYaayiKh-iNaa, wali mu'allimiNaa, Wali aSaaTiidZiNaa, Wa dZawil huquuqi 'Alaina, Wali Man AjRoo HaadZal Khoiro Fii HaadZiHis Saaq'ah,

Wa'an JaMii'in MusliMiiNaa Wal MusliMaat, Wal MukminiNaa Wal Muq'miNaat, Al AhYaaq'i Minhum Wal AmWaat, inNaka Mujiibud Da'aWaat, Wa QooDhiyal HaaJaat, Wa GhoofirudZ-dZunuubi Wal KhooThii'at. BirohMatika Yaa Arhamar RohiiMiin.

AllooHumMa inNaa Nas’aluka RiDhooka Wal JanNah, Wa Naq ’UudZubika Miin SaKhotika Wan-Naar.

AllooHumMa inNaka AFuuwun KaRiim, TuhibBul Afwa Faq'fu AnNaa WaGh Fir LaNaa, Wa’an JaMiiq’il MusliMiiNaa Wal MusliMaat, Wal MukmiNiiNaa Wal MukmiNaat, Birohmatika Yaa Arhamar RohiiMiin.

AllooHumMa inNaa NasAluka SaLaamatTan Fid Diini Wad Dun-Yaa Wal Aahiroh, Wa Aafiyatan Fil Jasadi, Wa Shihhatan Fil Badani, Wa ZiYaa Datan Fil ‘ilmi, Wa Barokatan Fir-Rizqi, Wa Taubatan Qoblal Mauut, Wa Rohmatan ‘iindal Mauut, Wa MaGh-Firotaan Bakdal Mauut.

AllooHumMa HawWin AlaiNaa Fii SakaRootil Mauut, Wan-NaJaata MinNaan-Naari, Wal ‘Aqfwa 'indal Hisaab

AllooHumMaj’al DiinNaNaa DiinNan NaBiiyi MuhamMadin SholallooHu AlaiHi Wasallam. Wa islamaNaa islamal MusliMiin, Wa imanaNaa imaNaal MukmiNiin, Wa SholataNaa Sholataal KhooSyiq’iin, Wa ’akMaaLaNaa 'akMaaLaaSh SholiHiin, Wa NiiYaataNaa NiiYaatal MuhliSiin.
